skill_name: Describe how human behavior has caused a decrease in the population of elephants in Africa over the last two decades.
workflow: Humans have had a devastating effect on the elephant population in Africa over the last two decades. The main causes are poaching for ivory and meat, destruction of their habitat due to expanding human settlements and agriculture, and an inadequate level of enforcement of existing regulations and laws.
